observations.observed: Thai Snorlax GX HP190, printed AS1b, regulation A, 112/150 RR, Illus. 5ban Graphics. Colored foil reflections are visible on the border and card face; the owner confirms Holo. Listing metadata claiming 157/150, Kodama, Promo and Sushiro is inconsistent with the pictured card and is not adopted. The printed copyright year is not used as the release date. Positive Holo evidence only, with no finish-list closure.
